jokes.title: Борода
jokes.gist: A student asks a professor whether he sleeps with his beard over or under the blanket, and a week later the sleepless professor attacks him because he can no longer get comfortable either way.

lastLine.text: Неделю уже спать не могу — и так неудобно, и так неудобно!

jokes.title: Магнитики
jokes.gist: Burglars see fridge magnets only from notorious prison-camp towns, take the owner for a hardened ex-convict, and respectfully feed his cat and wash the dishes.

firstLine.text: Увидев на холодильнике всего два магнитика — из Магадана и Воркуты,

jokes.title: Икота
jokes.gist: A senior doctor scolds a junior for telling an older woman she is pregnant, and the junior calmly notes that it did cure her hiccups.

jokes.title: Три лягушки
jokes.gist: Someone says his heart bleeds at the sight of preserved animals, and it turns out he pities not the three frogs but the ten liters of wasted alcohol.

firstLine.text: Ну просто сердце кровью обливается, как вижу этих заспиртованных животных!

lastLine.text: Вот именно — три лягушки. А спирта — литров десять!!

jokes.title: Слепые пилоты
jokes.gist: Two blind pilots take off only when passengers scream at the runway's end, and worry that one day the screaming will come too late.

firstLine.text: Два слепых пилота входят в самолёт.

lastLine.text: Знаешь что? Однажды они закричат слишком поздно, и мы все погибнем.

jokes.title: Перекрёсток
jokes.gist: Dead traffic cop offered the road to heaven or hell asks to stay at the crossroads, where traffic cops traditionally stand collecting bribes.

lastLine.text: А можно я здесь, на перекрестке останусь?

jokes.title: Роддом
jokes.gist: In a maternity waiting room each father's number of babies matches a number in his employer's name, and the last man panics because he works at 7-Eleven.

firstLine.text: Четверо мужчин сидят в комнате ожидания роддома, пока их жёны рожают.
